base_reason: Repeated public-data crypto Up/Down campaigns found theoretical complement opportunities but zero pessimistic paired fills at base 100-share quote size across 7 separated windows with trade evidence READY. This is a queue-position/execution failure under current assumptions, not a mathematical rejection of complement arbitrage.
maker_fee_assumption: 0 (standard Polymarket maker-rebate structure, treated as zero for conservative assumption)
size_ladder_note: Replay over the original campaign was impossible because raw cumulative fillable-volume evidence was not stored. Fresh capture was insufficient because the original crypto Up/Down markets had expired and no equivalent active duration universe was available. The 60-second fallback run is recorded as a diagnostic stub, not as sufficient ladder evidence. The distinction between no fills at any size and edge only at dust size remains formally open.

campaign_phases.description: Precommitted repeated-window closeout across 6 separated windows on BTC and ETH crypto Up/Down duration markets (5m, 15m, 4h, daily). Base quote size 100 shares.
Post-closeout addendum testing the previously missing 1h slug family. Confirmed the same zero-fill pattern. Confirmatory only — does not change the base verdict.
Inspected existing shadow_opportunities.jsonl for raw queue evidence. Found critical missing field: cumulative_fillable_volume per leg. Replay over original campaign is arithmetically impossible.

60-second fallback diagnostic capture on the only remaining active market (bitcoin-up-or-down-on-may-17-2026). 6 opportunities, all classified dust at every ladder size [5, 10, 25, 50, 100]. Sample is below the campaign's own sufficiency gates. Original crypto Up/Down duration universe had expired.
campaign_phases.note: Does not settle the size-ladder question. Insufficient sample from an expired-universe fallback market.

limitations: Frozen status applies to base 100-share pessimistic maker execution only
